song.title: Still
song.lyrics:
[V1] Intro: F Am C G x2 .C G Am F D G Hide me now, Under Your wings .C G Am Dm G Cover me, within your mighty hands
[C1] . Em F G C When the oceans rise and thunders roar . F G Am I will soar with You above the storm . F G C Father You are King over the flood . Em F G 1.C-> I will be still know You are God
[V2] . C G Am F D G Find rest my soul, in Christ alone . C G Am Dm G Know His pow'r, in quietness and trust
song.author: Reuben Morgan
